title: 3B ORIGINS — Le Cercle Brisé
notes: Concepts are not screenshots or 3D models.
The limestone file is a colour texture, not a complete generated PBR set. Normal and roughness channels are reused from the separately credited plaster material.
Kaïs reuses the existing CC0-based animated avatar, not a new faithful sculpt of an official manga reference.
Guardian and statues are provisional; no role has been attributed to Céliane.
